column2: Paula;;;;;;;;;;;;;;04-12-2024 9:28;;;2024-12-04T12:28:25Z;;2024-02-28;;;;Educational leadership at early childhood education (ECE) has been extensively studied. However
column3: evidence from Chile is still scarce. As with many parts of the world
column4: the ECE workforce is very female-heavy and Chile is no exception to this. This situation presents an intriguing context for leadership studies as particularities of a gendered role for women as leaders in Chile has not been a matter of analysis. Leadership in ECE includes a sense of vocation or ‘passion’ for children’s care
column5: development
column6: and learning
column7: called caring leadership. This concept highlights an ethical component
column8: interpersonal relations and a concern for the well-being. This article presents the findings of a three-year study involving 12 women leaders in ECE who established a Professional Learning Community. They were interviewed throughout the research. Findings reveal three tensions. Firstly
column9: leadership is associated with a maternal role
column10: perpetuating gender stereotypes. The second tension addresses the dynamics of personal connections within ECE teams in terms of asymmetry or horizontality. The third tension arises from the significance of caring as a crucial aspect of working in ECE education. These tensions underscore the need for a critical analysis of leadership in ECE
column11: as gender considerations may overlook the complexity of the leaders’ role.;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;School Leadership & Management: Formerly School Organisation

column7: tomando en cuenta la perspectiva de las Neurociencias. Para esto
column8: se analizaron las estrategias que utilizaron tres Educadoras de Párvulos de los niveles de Prekinder y Kinder de un colegio municipal de la comuna de Peñalolén.

column1: Para la recolección de datos se realizaron observaciones de prácticas pedagógicas y se utilizaron dos instrumentos de evaluación. Luego se hizo un diagnóstico a partir de un análisis cualitativo; los resultados permitieron diseñar un plan de intervención que tiene como objetivo potenciar las habilidades de las educadoras en relación a la apropiación de Estrategias Pedagógicas que se utilizan en las experiencias de aprendizaje orientadas al desarrollo de Conciencia Fonológica.
La intervención diseñada consiste en un taller teórico
column2: práctico y participativo dirigido a Educadoras de Párvulos y personal afín con la enseñanza de la lectura y escritura de la institución observada
column3: y tiene una duración de 32 horas cronológicas a disponer durante un año

column1: pedagógico.
El alcance de esta investigación se ubica en la necesidad de fortalecer las habilidades de los niños en el proceso de adquisición del lenguaje escrito
column3: crecimiento y desarrollo en la sociedad actual
column4: marcada por cientos de avances tecnológicos en comunicación.

column1: Entre los hallazgos más importantes de esta investigación se encuentra la existencia de un potencial de mejora en relación a la variedad de Tareas Fonológicas que se ofrecen a los niños
column2: la progresiva complejidad de las mismas

column1: Esta investigación cualitativa está focalizada particularmente en el Diseño Universal para el Aprendizaje (DUA) y su concretización en las planificaciones elaboradas por un grupo de educadoras de párvulos de dos colegios particulares subvencionados pertenecientes a la Fundación Mano Amiga
column2: los cuales están ubicados en Santiago de Chile.

column1: Para investigar lo planteado anteriormente
column2: se utilizaron dos instrumentos de recolección de datos: cuestionario y lista de cotejo
column3: ambos validados por juicio de expertos. Se aplicó el cuestionario a través de la realización de entrevistas a todas las educadoras de párvulos de los ciclos iniciales de los dos colegios y además se analizó un grupo de planificaciones elaboradas por ellas aplicando la lista de cotejo; desde los datos recogidos
column4: se realizó un diagnóstico
column5: basado en una valoración cualitativa y en un análisis de frecuencia de indicadores.

column1: A partir del diagnóstico
column2: se implementó una Propuesta de Intervención
column3: en la cual participaron todas las educadoras de párvulos de ambos colegios; en dicha propuesta se consideraron tanto elementos teóricos como prácticos
column4: diversos tipos de evaluación y se concluyó con la reformulación de una planificación en la cual se visibilizara la incorporación del DUA y sus Principios.

column1: Finalmente y de manera posterior a la implementación de la Propuesta de Intervención
column2: se analizó un segundo grupo de planificaciones
column3: utilizando la misma lista de cotejo
column4: y a partir del análisis de los resultados se levantaron conclusiones que permitieron dar respuesta a cada uno de los objetivos de la investigación.

column1: El alcance de esta investigación recae en un proceso vigente
column2: que conlleva cambios en el sistema educativo chileno
column3: donde levantar una perspectiva sobre la implementación

column1: vii
del DUA y propiciar las bases para futuros estudios en este ámbito
column2: se transforma en un importante aporte para promover la diversificación de una enseñanza que promueva una inclusión real de todos y cada uno de los estudiantes del país. A su vez
column3: con este estudio se busca motivar a otros profesionales a cuestionarse y reflexionar en torno a la relevancia que adquieren las planificaciones
column4: como uno de los ejes fundamentales de las buenas prácticas docentes y de la concretización de una educación diversificada.

column1: Entre los principales hallazgos de este estudio
column2: se pudo evidenciar que las educadoras de párvulos mencionaron en las entrevistas conocer el DUA
column3: sin embargo los niveles de conocimiento de ellas resultaron ser iniciales y fragmentados (nivel Insuficiente).

column1: En el grupo de planificaciones pre intervención (diagnóstico)
column2: la presencia de los indicadores tanto del foco DUA como del foco Planificación
column3: se encontraron en la clasificación Insuficiente en ambos establecimientos
column4: lo que da cuenta de una congruencia entre un nivel de conocimiento Insuficiente del DUA y su concretización en las planificaciones
column5: también con un nivel Insuficiente.

column1: También se pudo observar que la presencia del DUA en las planificaciones elaboradas de manera posterior a la Propuesta de Intervención
column2: tanto en el foco DUA como en el foco Planificación
column3: continuó estando en la clasificación Insuficiente en ambos establecimientos y si bien no se alcanzaron resultados notoriamente significativos en todas las planificaciones elaboradas
column4: sí se visualizó una transformación y un incremento en la incorporación del DUA y en particular de algunos de los indicadores correspondientes a cada uno de los Principios. Cabe destacar
column5: que existieron indicadores que no estuvieron presentes ni en el grupo de planificaciones pre intervención ni en las planificaciones post intervención.";;;;;;;;;;;Proyecto de Aplicación Profesional (Magíster en Neurociencias aplicadas a la educación infantil)--Universidad Finis Terrae

column4: the anxiety levels of the students were described according to sex (male/female)

column9: 546 protocol activations were identified. The median age was 69 years (IQR: 56–78)

column12: and inpatient wards (11.8%). The most common SIRS criteria were tachycardia (75.6%)
column13: tachypnea (50.4%)
column14: and fever (48.5%). Prevalent organ dysfunctions included hypotension (53%)

column4: Alfredo";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;12-10-2022 8:32;;;12-10-2022 8:32;;2022-09-06;;;;;A new variant of the Pickup and Delivery Routing problem is presented. Given a set of customers

column8: the Pickup to Delivery Drone Routing Problem (PDDRP) aims to find a drone scheduling such that a drone serves the customer’s order from a set of available facilities. Each drone starts in the depot
column9: flies to pickup the customer’s order in a facility
column10: and continues its flight to deliver the parcel to a customer. Then
column11: the drone begins another service
column12: and once its last service is completed
column13: it returns to the depot. The objective is to minimize the makespan associated with the drone fleet. The layer of facilities forcing drones to visit one of them to pickup the parcel makes the problem different from traditional pickup and delivery routing problems. Three mixed-linear programming models are presented to obtain optimal solutions for the problem. The first model is related to the multiple Traveling Salesman Problem (m-TSP)
column14: the second is associated with the Parallel Machine Scheduling Problem (PMS)
column15: and the third was developed specifically for the new problem. Given the high computational complexity of the PDDRP
column16: a Greedy Randomized Adaptive Search Procedure (GRASP) was designed to find near-optimal solutions when exact approaches cannot achieve (near) optimal solutions. Computational experiments show that a commercial solver could solve only small problem instances. GRASP can find reasonable solutions in a short time when medium and large instance sizes need to be solved. Finally

Each story contained two motion-based metaphors
column8: two static space-based metaphors
column9: two static object-based metaphors
column10: and two static event-based metaphors. After listening to each story
column11: they had to retell the stories in front of a camera. The videos were analyzed to determine the number of metaphoric gestures and beat gestures that had been used by participants during the retelling of the stories. column12: static object-based metaphors

column14: respectively. On the other hand
column15: the highest number of beat gestures was used with static event-based metaphors. These findings indicate that the use of metaphoric gestures and beat gestures accompanying metaphors is highly dependent on the spatial and motoric properties of the base of the metaphors

column2: Omid;;;;;;;;;;;;;;25-11-2024 11:48;;;2024-11-25T14:48:26Z;;2023-11-03;;;;This study examined the embodied realization of the Persian term dæqi:qæn (exactly) when embodied through gestures. A group of thirty Persian native speakers were asked to express their opinions about six subjects in an interview setting. During the interview
column3: the interviewer used some techniques to elicit the term dæqi:qæn from the participants. The types of gestures produced when participants used the term dæqi:qæn were analyzed. The results showed that the term dæqi:qæn was embodied primarily by forward hand gestures and to a lesser degree by forward head gestures. This suggests that a given term can be embodied across various parts of the body
column4: but degree of realization of this embodiment process is not the same in all involved body parts. While some body parts are strongly involved and actively employed to embody a concept in gestures
column5: other parts may be less involved or not involved at all. We call this process distributed embodiment. The term dæqi:qæn was strongly embodied in forward hand gestures

column4: Chile;;12-09-2019 10:59;;;2019-09-12T13:59:56Z;;2018;;;;;;;;La simulación clínica es una instancia en la formación académica del odontólogo donde se van a adquirir las destrezas y se van a desarrollar las habilidades necesarias para su futuro desempeño profesional. La retroalimentación convencional es la forma que se usa hoy en día como método de evaluación al alumno en Simulación Clínica II en la Universidad Finis Terrae
column5: la cual consiste en una conversación directa del docente con el alumno dónde el docente le muestra y explica los aciertos y errores cometidos en el trabajo realizado. En el último tiempo se ha hecho más común el uso de medios digitales como método de apoyo en la educación. La integración de estos sistemas proporcionaría una retroalimentación más precisa y objetiva a los alumnos
column6: ayudando a solucionar el problema de la subjetividad que se da en la retroalimentación convencional. Es por esto que en este estudio se comparó la efectividad de ambas retroalimentaciones a través del análisis de la divergencia de la pared vestibular y lingual del cajón oclusal de una preparación para restauración metálica indirecta. Se obtuvo un total de 43 participantes
column7: los que en una primera instancia realizaron la preparación solicitada
column8: luego se dividió de forma aleatoria en dos grupos (15 alumnos recibieron retroalimentación mediante una imagen 2D procesada digitalmente y 13 recibieron una retroalimentación de tipo convencional)

column2: Paulina;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;03-11-2022 10:11;;;03-11-2022 10:11;;2021-10-21;;;;;;;The prognosis of severe COVID-19 patients has motivated research communities to uncover mechanisms of SARS-CoV-2 pathogenesis also on a regional level. In this work
column3: we aimed to understand the immunological dynamics of severe COVID-19 patients with different degrees of illness
column4: and upon long-term recovery. We analyzed immune cellular subsets and SARS-CoV-2-specific antibody isotypes of 66 COVID-19 patients admitted to the Hospital Clínico Universidad de Chile
column5: which were categorized according to the WHO ten-point clinical progression score. These included 29 moderate patients (score 4-5) and 37 severe patients under either high flow oxygen nasal cannula (18 patients
column6: score 6)
column7: or invasive mechanical ventilation (19 patients
column8: score 7-9)
column9: plus 28 convalescent patients and 28 healthy controls. Furthermore
column10: six severe patients that recovered from the disease were longitudinally followed over 300 days. Our data indicate that severe COVID-19 patients display increased frequencies of plasmablasts
column11: activated T cells and SARS-CoV-2-specific antibodies compared to moderate and convalescent patients. Remarkably
column12: within the severe COVID-19 group
column13: patients rapidly progressing into invasive mechanical ventilation show higher frequencies of plasmablasts
column14: monocytes
column15: eosinophils
column16: Th1 cells and SARS-CoV-2-specific IgG than patients under high flow oxygen nasal cannula. These findings demonstrate that severe COVID-19 patients progressing into invasive mechanical ventilation show a distinctive type of immunity. In addition
column17: patients that recover from severe COVID-19 begin to regain normal proportions of immune cells 100 days after hospital discharge and maintain high levels of SARS-CoV-2-specific IgG throughout the study
column18: which is an indicative sign of immunological memory. Thus
column19: this work can provide useful information to better understand the diverse outcomes of severe COVID-19 pathogenesis.;;;;;;;This work was supported by a grant from the COVID-19 research program of the National Agency for Research and Development (ANID)

column2: Jorge Vera;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;15-12-2021 15:55;;;15-12-2021 15:55;;2021-09-21;;;;;Andes orthohantavirus (ANDV) is endemic in Argentina and Chile and is the primary etiological agent of hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS) in South America. ANDV is unique among other members of the Hantaviridae family of viruses because of its ability to spread from person to person. The molecular mechanisms driving ANDV protein synthesis remain poorly understood. A previous report showed that translation of the Small segment mRNA (SmRNA) of ANDV relied on both the 5’cap and the 3’untranslated region (UTR) of the SmRNA. In this new study
column3: we further characterize the mechanism by which the 5’ and 3’end of the SmRNA interact to assure viral protein synthesis. We establish that the viral nucleocapsid protein N and the cellular protein hMex3A participate in the process. column2: Pedro;;;;;;;;Estados Unidos;;;;;;23-06-2026 10:32;;;2026-06-23T14:32:54Z;;2026;;;;Este artículo analiza las estrategias peritextuales mediante las cuales Hugo Correa y Antonio Montero buscaron legitimar la ciencia ficción chilena entre 1959 y 1977. A partir de un corpus compuesto por un prólogo y dos entrevistas
column3: se examinan los modos en que ambos autores intentaron dotar de prestigio al género en un contexto de recepción crítica desfavorable. El estudio sostiene que Montero vincula la ciencia ficción con el discurso científico y universitario
column4: mientras Correa la reinscribe en relación con el canon occidental y el realismo fantástico. Sin embargo
column5: ambas estrategias comparten una paradoja central: la valoración del género no se funda en sus méritos estéticos autónomos
column6: sino en su subordinación a formas de legitimación externas. En consecuencia
column7: la ciencia ficción chilena aparece menos como una práctica literaria afirmada en su especificidad que como un espacio de negociación simbólica con discursos de mayor prestigio cultural. column2: Franklin León;;;;;;;;España;;;;;;19-01-2026 9:33;;;2026-01-19T12:33:03Z;;2023;;;;"La presente investigación analiza la crisis de representación en las democracias contemporáneas para proponer

column1: El primer capítulo examina las aporías del sistema representativo liberal y el resurgimiento de las demandas por democracia directa. Tras evaluar las ventajas y limitaciones de ambos modelos

column2: Katherine;;;;;;;;;;;;;;30-07-2024 12:11;;;2024-07-30T16:11:05Z;;2024-07-29;;;;"Low back pain (LBP) is one of the most prevalent musculoskeletal disorders in adults worldwide. Alterations in postural and lumbopelvic control and functionality appear to be determining factors in its resolution. Methods: A cross-sectional study was performed. Patients with LBP were enrolled. Lumbar pain; postural control (PC)
column3: total area of the center of pressure (TACOP)
column4: and the velocity of the center of pressure (VCOP); lumbopelvic control (LPC); and functionality were evaluated. Statistical tests were implemented to determine differences between sex and age and correlation models among the variables. Results: Thirty adult patients with LBP were analyzed. A strong relationship was found between pain and functionality [r = 0.64; p < 0.001]. A moderate relationship was found between pain and TACOP [r = 0.395; p = 0.031]. A moderate relationship was observed between TACOP and functionality [0.413; p = 0.023] and between LPC and TACOP [r = 0.416; p = 0.001]. Conclusions: This study demonstrates the significant impact of LBP on postural control
column5: lumbopelvic control
column6: and functionality. These results highlight the importance of addressing postural and lumbopelvic control in LBP treatment. No significant differences based on gender and age were found
column7: but all clinical variables differed significantly between the LBP and control groups
column8: underscoring the unique impairments associated with LBP.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Journal of Clinical Medicine

column8: y se sostiene que el mestizaje y el sincretismo cultural configuraron una identidad nacional común que difumina la distinción entre acreedores y diferenciados. El capítulo II aborda las demandas del pueblo mapuche: la reivindicación territorial
column9: la autodeterminación y las obligaciones autoimpuestas. El capítulo III estudia la legislación como vía de integración. En ese capítulo se estudia el convenio número 169 de la OIT

column11: sino que las demandas del pueblo mapuche deben evaluarse conforme a los principios del Estado de derecho

column5: practitioners face persistent challenges such as capturing tacit knowledge
column6: managing diverse stakeholder needs
column7: and addressing ambiguities in requirements. Moreover
column8: although elicitation is recognized as a core process for gathering and analyzing system objectives
column9: there is a lack of a unified and systematic framework to guide practitioners—especially newcomers—through the activity. To address these challenges
column10: we provide a comprehensive analysis of existing elicitation methods
column11: aiming to contribute to better alignment between software products and project objectives
column12: ultimately improving software engineering practices. We do so by performing a systematic literature review identifying crosscutting steps
column13: common techniques
column14: tools
column15: and approaches that define the core activities of the elicitation process. We synthesize our findings into a metamodel that structures software elicitation processes. This review uncovers various elicitation methods—such as collaborative workshops
column16: interviews
column17: and prototyping—each demonstrating unique strengths in different project contexts. It also highlights significant limitations
column18: including stakeholder misalignment and incomplete requirements capture
column19: which continue to reduce the effectiveness of elicitation processes. Finally
column20: our study seeks to contribute to understanding requirements elicitation methods by providing a comprehensive view of their current strengths and limitations through a metamodel enabling the structuring and optimization of elicitation processes.;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Processes

column3: Chile;;;;;;26-12-2017 21:24;;;26-12-2017 21:24;;2016;;;;"El presente estudio corresponde a una revisión de la literatura sobre

column1: Prótesis Parcial Metálica Inmediata en pacientes desdentados parciales y el

selección de población a individuos desdentados parciales con indicación de
exodoncias y necesidad de rehabilitación oral inmediata y definitiva
intervención de prótesis metálicas parciales inmediatas definitivas; considerando

Para la evaluación de los resultados se contempló la satisfacción del
paciente a corto plazo y la evolución de la cicatrización post exodoncia.

metálica inmeditata parcial en pacientes desdentados parciales
corto plazo su necesidad protésica definitiva y además se observa una mejor
cicatrización de la zona de extracción dentaria. Esto indica que esta posibilidad
protésica constituye un tratamiento basado en la salud
ventajas de una prótesis metálica protegiendo los tejidos gingivales y dentarios
remanentes del paciente.";;;;;;;;;;;;;Tesis (Cirujano Dentista)--Universidad Finis Terrae

column13: using HL7 FHIR resources as the message format. The system comprises four core components: (1) the Connector
column14: which ingests raw hospital data and converts it into standardised healthcare formats; (2) the Writer

column16: which hosts ML models and generates patient-specific alerts; and (4) the Model Evaluator
column17: which supports prospective monitoring of model performance. Alerts are displayed through the BIAlert user interface and can also be integrated directly into the electronic health record (EHR). BIAlert is currently deployed and operating in real-time clinical settings in two hospitals

column2: Danyal;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;03-11-2022 8:46;;;03-11-2022 8:46;;2022-06;;;;;Visual attention is an important indicator in teacher-student interactions. This article presents the results of a study aimed to determine how the visual attention paid to the teacher by students fluctuates during their math and English classes and to detect possible differences in their attention. The study was conducted in a secondary school with a sample of 16 male students. Data was obtained by a mini video camera mounted on glasses wore by students. Using google images
column3: we automatically and objectively analyzed 2613 frames from the recordings where the teacher appeared in the students’ visual field. Results show a difference in students’ visual attention between introvert and extrovert students throughout the 90-minute class. It was also observed that students were more visually engaged when the teacher's speech was accompanied by gestures. The paper highlights the importance of diversifying interactions that seek other ways to engage students in the last two-thirds of the class. Some implications for professional development programs are derived from this study ;;"La atención visual es un indicador importante en las interacciones entre docentes y estudiantes. Este artículo presenta los resultados de un estudio que buscó determinar cómo fluctúa la atención visual que los estudiantes prestan a la persona docente durante sus clases de matemáticas e inglés y detectar posibles diferencias en dicha atención. El estudio se llevó a cabo en una escuela secundaria con una muestra de 16 estudiantes (varones). Los datos se obtuvieron a través de una mini cámara de video
column4: montada sobre las gafas que son usadas por los estudiantes. A través del uso de imágenes de Google
column5: analizamos de manera automática y objetiva 2613 fotogramas de las grabaciones en las que la persona docente de la clase aparecía en el campo visual de los estudiantes. Los resultados dan cuenta de la diferencia en la atención visual de los estudiantes entre los introvertidos y los extrovertidos durante los 90 minutos de clase. También se observó que los estudiantes estaban más comprometidos visualmente cuando el discurso de la persona docente estaba acompañado de gestos. Se destaca la importancia de diversificar las interacciones que busque otras formas de comprometer a los estudiantes en los últimos dos tercios de la clase. Algunas implicaciones para los programas de desarrollo profesional se derivan de este estudio.

column2: Francisca;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;19-01-2022 8:50;;;19-01-2022 8:50;;2021-09-28;;;;;Pomegranate peel is an agro-industrial residue obtained after fruit processing with high total polyphenol (TP) content
column3: making it an attractive by-product for its reuse. Pomegranate peel extract (PPE) and its bioactive compounds have shown positive effects on obesity models. Effects on favouring mitochondrial biogenesis and function have also been described. However
column4: once phenolic compounds are extracted
column5: their stability can be affected by diverse factors. Microencapsulation could improve PPE stability
column6: allowing its incorporation into functional foods. Nevertheless
column7: studies on the potential biological effects of PPE microparticles (MPPE) in obesity models are lacking. This study aims to evaluate the effect of MPPE on brown adipose tissue (BAT) mitochondrial structure and function and metabolic alterations related to obesity in mice fed a high-fat diet (HFD). PPE was microencapsulated by spray drying using inulin (IN) as a wall material and physically-chemically characterised. Eight-week-old male C57BL/6J mice (n 40) were randomly distributed into five groups: control diet (CD)
column8: HFD
column9: HFD + IN
column10: HFD + PPE (50 mg/kg per d TP) and HFD + MPPE (50 mg/kg per d TP)
column11: for 14 weeks. A glucose tolerance test and indirect calorimetry were conducted. Blood and adipose tissue samples were obtained. MPPE supplementation prevented HFD-induced body weight gain (P < 0·001)
column12: fasting glycaemia (P = 0·007) and total cholesterol rise (P = 0·001). MPPE resulted in higher BAT mitochondrial complex IV activity (P = 0·03) and prevented HFD-induced mitochondrial cristae alteration (P = 0·02). In conclusion
column13: MPPE prevented HFD-induced excessive body weight gain and associated metabolic disturbances
column14: potentially by activating complex IV activity and preserving mitochondrial cristae structure in BAT in mice fed with a HFD.;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;British Journal of Nutrition

column5: 2025;"Este trabajo de título se desarrolló un modelo de optimización con el objetivo de complementar el sistema de vigilancia actual que posee el Parque Nacional Queulat
column6: esto mediante la localización eficiente de drones atados t casetas de vigilancia. Elmodelo formulado es una combinación del problema de localización y el problema de cubrimiento de conjuntos
column7: el cual fue implementado en IBM ILOG CPLEX con el objetivo de identificar la solución optima que maximice la cobertura de los puntos de riesgo y minimice el costo de instalación.

column1: La solución considera restricciones de operación
column2: como la capacidad máxima de vigilancia del dron atado y caseta de vigilancia
column3: y limites de distancia de cobertura por distancia (hasta 399 metros para las casetas y desde 400 y 2000 metros para los drones atados). La combinación de estos parámetros permitió obtener resultados factibles y coherentes con la realidad geográfica del parque. Se logro cubrir los 101 puntos de riesgo definidos
column4: utilizando el mínimo de casetas y drones atados instalados a lo largo de todo el territorio que se quería cubrir.

column1: El análisis de sensibilidad realizado demostró que la capacidad de vigilancia de los drones atados es un parámetro crucial para mantener un equilibrio en el modelo que se desarrolló. Al aumentar la capacidad de los drones atados reduce la cantidad de recursos que se instalaron
column2: pero esto genero una sobrecarga de vigilancia
column3: lo que es poco aplicable a la realidad del Parque Nacional Queulat. A su vez
column4: se demostró que las restricciones de los limites de distancia de cobertura influyen directamente en la distribución de los recursos
column5: lo que genero una viabilidad del modelo que se desarrolló matemáticamente.

column2: Pamela Raquel;;;;;;;;;;;;;;10-04-2025 12:26;;;2025-04-10T16:26:02Z;;2025-02-21;;;;The rising demand for bioactive compounds from marine resources highlights the need for sustainable separation technologies. This study introduces an integrated process combining ultrasound-assisted extraction (USAE) and resin purification (RP) to isolate phlorotannins from Durvillaea incurvata
column3: a brown seaweed with significant biomedical potential. Using a 32.5% ethanol–water solvent system for USAE followed by RP on Diaion HP-20 resin
column4: phlorotannins were enriched 2.4-fold
column5: with simultaneous removal of interfering compounds such as mannitol (~100%)
column6: which was demonstrated by FTIR and HPLC-IR analysis. Advanced characterization using UHPLC-QToF-MS/MS identified five novel phlorotannins with polymerization degrees of 3 to 8 phloroglucinol units in both USAE extracts and post-RP. Mass balance based on spectrophotometric measurements indicated a purification factor of ~2
column7: confirming process effectiveness. RP streams showed distinct phlorotannin profiles
column8: with one phlorotannin exceeding 70% relative abundance. However
column9: MS/MS results showed significantly lower recoveries than spectrophotometric data
column10: revealing a novel insight into RP purification. These findings highlight the critical role of comprehensive chemical characterization in optimizing sustainable phlorotannin extraction from seaweed. They propose a framework for scalable
column11: eco-efficient technologies for achieving high-purity phlorotannin recovery. This approach facilitates the development of phlorotannin-based applications in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical industries.;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Antioxidants

column2: Katherine;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;15-11-2022 10:40;;;15-11-2022 10:40;;2022-03-31;;;;;Corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives are common in the mining industry and have the watchful eye of their stakeholders. However
column3: limited attention has been given to the perceptions of the host communities regarding these initiatives. This paper seeks to explore the perceptions of a host community
column4: located in the north of Chile
column5: regarding the CSR initiatives of mining companies close to their community. Through a qualitative methodology
column6: nine semi-structured interviews (to residents and workers of the host community) are conducted. The data are analyzed with the thematic analysis technique and
column7: together with the theoretical lenses of the CSR pyramid and the stakeholder theory
column8: the results are obtained. The main findings indicate that the host community perceives different responsibilities regarding the CSR initiatives of the mining industry. These dimensions comprise the level of importance perceived by the community
column9: from the bottom (most important) to the top of the pyramid (least important)
column10: such as environmental responsibility
column11: responsibility for health and safety well-being
column12: ethical responsibility
column13: economic responsibility
column14: legal responsibility
column15: and finally
column16: philanthropic responsibility. The investigation contributes to the literature on CSR in the mining industry
column17: generating practical implications for public policies
column18: the management of mining companies and the leaders of the host community.;;"Las iniciativas de responsabilidad social empresarial (RSE) son comunes en la industria minera y cuentan con una atenta mirada de sus stakeholders. Sin embargo
column19: es limitada la atención que se le ha prestado a las percepciones que las comunidades anfitrionas tienen sobre ellas. El presente artículo busca explorar las percepciones de una comunidad anfitriona
column20: ubicada en el norte de Chile
column21: respecto a las iniciativas de RSE de las empresas mineras cercanas. Mediante una metodología cualitativa
column22: se realizan nueve entrevistas semiestructuradas (a residentes y trabajadores de la comunidad anfitriona); se analizan los datos con la técnica de análisis temático y
column23: junto a los lentes teóricos de la pirámide de RSE y la teoría de stakeholders
column24: se obtienen los resultados. Los principales hallazgos indican que la comunidad anfitriona percibe diferentes responsabilidades respecto a las iniciativas de RSE de la industria minera. Estas dimensiones comprenden el nivel de importancia percibido
column25: desde la base (más importante) a la punta de la pirámide (menos importante)
column26: como la responsabilidad ambiental
column27: la responsabilidad hacia el bienestar en salud y seguridad
column28: la responsabilidad ética
column29: la responsabilidad económica
column30: la responsabilidad legal
column31: y finalmente
column32: la responsabilidad filantrópica. La investigación contribuye a la literatura de RSE en la industria minera
column33: generando implicancias prácticas en las políticas públicas
column34: en la administración de las mineras y en los líderes de la comunidad anfitriona.

column2: Thomas;;;;;;;;Estados Unidos;;;;;;24-02-2026 15:15;;;2026-02-24T18:15:05Z;;2024-09;;;;"Background: It has been postulated that chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a state of relative 11?-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 (11?HSD2) insufficiency
column3: resulting in increased cortisol-mediated mineralocorticoid receptor (MR) activation. We hypothesized that relative 11?HSD2 insufficiency manifests across a wide spectrum of progressively declining kidney function
column4: including within the normal range.

column1: Methods: Adult participants were recruited at 2 academic centers. A discovery cohort (n = 500) enrolled individuals with estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) ranging from normal to CKD stage 5
column2: in whom serum cortisol-to-cortisone (F/E) was measured as a biomarker of 11?HSD2 activity. A validation cohort (n = 101) enrolled only individuals with normal kidney function (eGFR ? 60 mL/min/1.73 m2) in whom 11?HSD2 activity was assessed via serum F/E and 11-hydroxy-to-11-keto androgen (11OH/K) ratios following multiple maneuvers: oral sodium suppression test
column4: and ACTH-stimulation test (ACTHstim).

column1: Results: In the discovery cohort
column2: lower eGFR was associated with higher F/E (P-trend < .001). Similarly
column4: with normal eGFR
column5: an inverse association between eGFR and both F/E and 11OH/K ratios was observed (P-trend < .01)
column6: which persisted following DST (P-trend < .001) and ACTHstim (P-trend < .05). The fractional excretion of potassium
column7: a marker of renal MR activity
column8: was higher with higher F/E (P-trend < .01) and with lower eGFR (P-trend < .0001).

column1: Conclusion: A continuum of declining 11?HSD2 activity was observed with progressively lower eGFR in individuals spanning a wide spectrum of kidney function
column2: including those with apparently normal kidney function. These findings implicate cortisol-mediated MR activation in the pathophysiology of hypertension and cardiovascular disease in CKD.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;The Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism

column1: definir si existían o no diferencias significativas en el grado de resistencia
adhesiva logrado con restauraciones de resina compuesta realizadas con la
técnica de grabado ácido convencional y la técnica de grabado ácido modificada
utilizando un adhesivo de grabado y lavado.
Para obtener los datos se utilizaron 30 terceros molares siguiendo los criterios de
inclusión y exclusión del estudio. Estos molares se almacenaron en una solución
de suero fisiológico (solución salina al 0
temperatura ambiente hasta el momento que se sometieron al procedimiento
adhesivo.
Los dientes fueron separados en dos grupos que fueron sometidos a dos técnicas
adhesivas; la técnica estándar y la técnica modificada. La técnica estándar
consistió en grabado del esmalte con ácido fosfórico al 37% por 20 segundos
previo secado de la superficie. Luego se lavó por 40 segundos y después de secar
10 segundos el esmalte se aplicó una primera capa de adhesivo estándar por 10
segundos. Después de este tiempo se procedió al adelgazamiento de esta capa
de adhesivo con aire para aplicar una segunda capa de adhesivo por 10 segundos
y foto activarla por 20 segundos. Finalmente se realizó una restauración de resina
compuesta con técnica incremental. La técnica modificada consistió en pre grabar
el esmalte seco con ácido fosfórico al 37% por 10 segundos para luego lavar y
secar por 20 y 10 segundos respectivamente. Luego se volvió a grabar el esmalte
por 10 segundos más y se lavó y seco por 20 y 10 segundos respectivamente.
Después de esto la técnica continúo con la aplicación de la primera capa de
adhesivo convencional por 10 segundos y su respectivo adelgazamiento con aire
v
seguido de una segunda capa y foto activación por 20 segundos. Finalmente se
realizó otra restauración de resina compuesta con técnica incremental.
Cuando se terminó de adherir todas las restauraciones a las muestras se
confeccionó un zócalo acrílico de 20x20 milímetros donde se insertó la muestra
para asegurar una buena prensión de la platina a la hora de medir en el
newtómetro. Los datos fueron tabulados y trasformados a MPa para luego ser
sometidos al análisis estadístico.

Dysregulations of NAD metabolism are widely regarded as detrimental to health
column3: with NAD depletion commonly implicated in aging. However
column4: the extent to which cellular NAD concentration can decline without adverse consequences remains unclear. To investigate this
column5: we generated a mouse model in which nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase (NAMPT)-mediated NAD+ biosynthesis was disrupted in adult skeletal muscle. The intervention resulted in an 85% reduction in muscle NAD+ abundance while maintaining tissue integrity and functionality
column6: as demonstrated by preserved muscle morphology
column7: contractility
column8: and exercise tolerance. This absence of functional impairments was further supported by intact mitochondrial respiratory capacity and unaltered muscle transcriptomic and proteomic profiles. Furthermore
column9: lifelong NAD depletion did not accelerate muscle aging or impair whole-body metabolism. Collectively
column10: these findings suggest that NAD depletion does not contribute to age-related decline in skeletal muscle function.;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Cell Metabolism

column4: task performance

column1: The present study aimed to investigate the effects of a single bout of resistance exercise on mitophagy in human skeletal muscle (SkM).
Methods

Eight healthy men were recruited to complete an acute bout of one-leg resistance exercise. SkM biopsies were obtained one hour after exercise in the resting leg (Rest-leg) and the contracting leg (Ex-leg). Mitophagy was assessed using protein-related abundance
Results

Our results show that acute resistance exercise increased pro-fission protein phosphorylation (DRP1Ser616) and decreased mitophagy markers such as PARKIN and BNIP3L/NIX protein abundance in the Ex-leg. Additionally
column2: mitochondrial complex IV decreased in the Ex-leg when compared to the Rest-leg. In the Ex-leg
column3: TEM and immunofluorescence images showed mitochondrial cristae abnormalities
column4: a mitochondrial fission phenotype
column5: and increased mitophagosome-like structures in both subsarcolemmal and intermyofibrillar mitochondria. We also observed increased mitophagosome-like structures on the subsarcolemmal cleft and mitochondria in the extracellular space of SkM in the Ex-leg. We stimulated human primary myotubes with CCCP
column6: which mimics mitophagy induction in the Ex-leg
column7: and found that BNIP3L/NIX protein abundance decreased independently of lysosomal degradation. Finally
column8: in another human cohort
column9: we found a negative association between BNIP3L/NIX protein abundance with both mitophagosome-like structures and mitochondrial cristae density in the SkM.

column1: Conclusion
The findings suggest that a single bout of resistance exercise can initiate mitophagy
column3: in human skeletal muscle. BNIP3L/NIX is proposed as a sensitive marker for assessing mitophagy flux in SkM.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;"Acta Physiologica

Finally
column9: we determined that among the different SCFAs evaluated
column10: butyrate was the most potent
column11: reducing chronic ethanol intake in a dose–response manner. These findings support a key role of SCFAs

column6: 2025;"La crisis hídrica impacta directamente en la disponibilidad
column7: acceso y calidad de los alimentos
column8: comprometiendo la seguridad alimentaria y calidad de vida. Las comunidades se han visto obligadas a implementar estrategias para enfrentar los efectos de la escasez o exceso de agua. El objetivo principal de esta revisión bibliográfica fue analizar el impacto de la crisis hídrica en la seguridad alimentaria de las comunidades
column9: identificando los grupos más afectados
column10: los efectos específicos sobre la seguridad alimentaria y las estrategias implementadas. Se realizó una revisión siguiendo los lineamientos PRISMA y el esquema PICO (Población
column11: Intervención/Exposición
column12: Comparación
column13: Resultado). Las bases de datos utilizadas fueron PubMed y SciELO. Las búsquedas incluyeron términos como water crisis
column14: food security
column15: agriculture y climate change
column16: combinados mediante operadores booleanos (AND
column17: OR). Se incluyeron artículos en inglés y español
column18: publicados en los últimos 11 años (2014-2025). Se analizaron 9 artículos
column19: donde los resultados evidenciaron que los efectos de la crisis hídrica varían según el tipo de comunidad y su contexto geográfico. Las comunidades indígenas fueron las más afectadas debido a su alta

column1: dependencia a la agricultura y recursos limitados
column2: seguidas de las agrícolas-rurales que están ligadas a la economía a nivel regional. En contraste
column3: las comunidades urbanas enfrentan riesgos asociados al saneamiento y la inocuidad del agua. Las estrategias fueron mayoritariamente reactivas y su efectividad dependió de la cohesión social
column4: los recursos económicos y el apoyo institucional. Se concluye que la crisis hídrica afecta de manera diferenciada la seguridad alimentaria según el tipo de comunidad. Estos hallazgos subrayan la necesidad de diseñar políticas públicas diferenciadas que reconozcan las particularidades de cada comunidad. Asimismo
column5: se recomienda avanzar en la incorporación de indicadores específicos de seguridad alimentaria y nutricional
column6: así como en el desarrollo de estudios longitudinales y comparativos que orienten intervenciones más eficaces frente al cambio climático.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12254/7540;;;;spa;;;;;;Universidad Finis Terrae (Chile) Facultad de Medicina;;;;;;;;;;;;Acceso abierto;;Atribución-NoComercial-CompartirIgual 3.0 Chile (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 CL);https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/cl/;;;;;;;;;Seguridad alimentaria||Crisis hídrica||Cambioclimático||Agricultura||Comunidad rural||Población indígena;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;¿Cómo afecta la crisis hídrica en la seguridad alimentaria de las comunidades?;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Thesis;http://purl.org/coar/resource_type/c_46ec;;;;;;;;;;;;;

column3: its comparative effectiveness versus other treatments remains uncertain. Objective: To evaluate the effectiveness of arthrocentesis compared with other therapeutic modalities in patients with TMD
column4: focusing on pain relief and mandibular functional outcomes. Methods: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted following PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Primary outcomes were pain intensity assessed by visual analogue scale (VAS) and mandibular functional outcomes
column5: including maximum mouth opening
column6: maximum incisal opening
column7: masticatory efficiency
column8: mandibular movements
column9: and overall joint mobility. Results: Thirty-two randomized controlled trials were included in the quantitative synthesis. No statistically significant difference in pain reduction was observed between arthrocentesis and comparator interventions
column10: with very high heterogeneity. Masticatory efficiency showed a small statistically significant improvement favoring arthrocentesis
column11: based on very low-certainty evidence. Overall
column12: the certainty of evidence ranged from low to very low across outcomes. Conclusions: Arthrocentesis may provide modest symptomatic improvement in selected patients with TMD; however
column13: it does not demonstrate superiority over alternative therapeutic modalities for most functional outcomes. Further well-designed randomized controlled trials with standardized diagnostic criteria
column14: clearly defined comparators
column15: and longer follow-up are required to better define the role of arthrocentesis in the management of temporomandibular disorders.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Japanese Dental Science Review

column1: Los sellantes dentales corresponden a una barrera física que impide el acceso de
bacterias y detritus en las fosas y fisuras de los dientes. Existen dos tipos
principales de sellantes según la estrategia de adhesión: sellantes de grabado y
lavado y sellantes de autograbado
Hipótesis:
La estrategia de adhesión es uno de los factores que modifica la interacción de
sellantes de fosas y fisuras– superficie del esmalte dental en función del tiempo.
Objetivo General:
Determinar que la estrategia de adhesión modifica la interacción de sellantes de
fosas y fisuras – superficie del esmalte dental en el tiempo.
Material y Método:
La muestra está constituida por 44 especímenes (molares y premolares
permanentes) obtenida desde el Archivo de la Unidad de Biología Pulpar y
Endodoncia de la Universidad Finis Terrae y proviene de un estudio preliminar
realizado el año 2008.(45) Los especímenes presentaban sellantes realizados con
diferente estrategia de adhesión y fueron analizados y procesaron para estudiar
las características de la interfase sellante – esmalte dental
morfológica. Los especímenes fueron observados mediante un microscopio
estéreo Nikon C-LEDS LV-TV y luego fueron cortados para ser observados en un
microscopio AxioStar (Zeiss

Chile and Mexico are the only countries in Latin America that possess robust vital registration systems and open access databases with marginal levels of missing cases. This offers a unique opportunity to quantify the subnational burden of pediatric sepsis
column5: identify healthcare system constrictions
column6: and guide targeted public health interventions.

column1: Methods: This retrospective longitudinal study analyzed official hospital discharge and non-fetal death records of pediatrics (<10 years old) from Chile and Mexico between 2014 and 2024. Age-standardized incidence (ASIR) and mortality (ASMR) rates
column4: were calculated to assess mortality relative to subnational hospital output. A novel dynamic risk stratification matrix was developed to classify ICD-10 sepsis-related causes into four risk/severity quadrants based on year-specific ASIR and MIR indicators.

column1: Results: A total of 656
column4: and 964
column5: 452 discharges and 77
column6: 252 deaths in Mexico were analyzed. Subnational trends were highly heterogeneous. Chile exhibited a predominantly low pediatric MIR (median <1%) with isolated hotspots with significant structural deviations to the North. High-everity sepsis causes in Chile were relatively rare. Conversely
column7: Mexico displayed an alarmingly high MIR (median 7.2%)
column8: with systemic persistency in States such as Chiapas and Nuevo León. Strikingly
column9: high-severity causes in Mexico (e.g.
column10: unspecified septicaemia
column11: bacterial meningitis) were highly frequent
column12: accounting for 88–97% of pediatric sepsis deaths. Furthermore
column13: systemic instances of code-specific MIR > 1.0 in Mexico suggest significant health system fragmentation and decoupling of hospital discharge from vital statistic registries.

column1: Conclusions: Pediatric sepsis in Latin America encompasses distinct realities
column2: ranging from localized critical care gaps to high lethality persistency. One-size-fits-all national policies may be inadequate. These findings advocate for precision public health
column4: data-driven interventions and specialized resource allocation based on high-risk subnational hotspot identification.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;BMC Public Health

column15: discusión y evaluación de talleres mediante proposiciones para las prácticas. column2: utili-zando términos MESH en PubMed y SCIELO en inglés y español. Se incluyeron artículos de los últimos 5 años (2019-2024) abordando los  pilares  del  manejo  en  urgencias:  antibioticoterapia
column4: inmovilización y desbridamiento.

column1: Resultados: De 2.883 artícu-los obtenidos en PubMed y SCIELO

column4: inmovilización
column5: desbridamiento y cierre de la herida.

column1: Discusión: La antibioticoterapia debe ser precoz
column3: aseo quirúrgico antes de 24 horas de la lesión según las características de la fractura
column4: cierre precoz de la herida. También
column5: manejo del dolor asociado a reducción e inmovi-lización y/o fijación. Además
column6: considerar el uso de antibioticoterapia local y continua o cierre-asistido-por-vacío (VAC) por especialistas. Es importante la creación de protocolos específicos para el sistema de  salud  chileno.

column1: Conclusiones: El médico general debe conocer los tiempos de administración antibiótica y desbridación
column2: optimizar el manejo del dolor farmacológicamente
column3: inmovilizar la fractura e indicar la profilaxis antitetánica. El especialista debe procurar un aseo quirúrgico y cierre de la herida precoz

column1: In this article

column3: with the aim of analyzing how reference is constructed in natural language
column4: especially in cases where local interpretive methods prove insufficient. Drawing on selected examples from five languages
column5: we argue that pronominal reference is not an isolated operation
column6: but rather a process that depends on discourse
column7: context
column8: and the beliefs shared among speakers. In contrast to classical models of meaning composition —such as those proposed by Heim

column18: during the Covid19 pandemic. It is an exploratory-descriptive study where 18 semi-structured interviews were conducted remotely to school teachers mothers between 26 and 44 years of age
column19: belonging to municipal
column20: private subsidized and private paid establishments of the Metropolitan region of Chile
column21: and analyzed through the narrative approach strategy. The sociology of the individual and gender lenses are considered as theoretical perspectives to analyze the participants' experiences. column1: Cocaine and stimulant consumption constitute a significant global issue and are associated with impaired social skills. However
column2: the relationship between substance abuse and intentional harm recognition remains unclear. Intentional harm recognition is a crucial social cognitive ability that allows individuals to determine whether a harmful action performed by another person is deliberate or accidental.

column1: Methods
The present study examined self-reported
column3: and neural responses associated with intentional harm recognition in n?=?19 cocaine polydrug users (COC) and n?=?19 healthy controls (HC). High-density electroencephalography (hdEEG) was used to measure brain activity during an Intentional Inference Task (IIT)
column4: which assesses fast intention recognition in scenarios involving deliberate or unintentional harm to people and objects. This study took place between 2014 and 2015 in Santiago
column5: Chile.

column1: Results
Behaviorally
column2: COC exhibited slower reaction times (RT) than HC. Event-related potential (ERP) analysis revealed late frontal differences in HC when attributing intentional harm
column3: while these differences were absent in COC.

column1: Conclusions

These findings suggest a potential shift in COC towards emotional over-involvement and away from rational cognitive assessment of social information. The present results provide new insights into the recognition of intentional harm processing in cocaine polydrug users and highlight the potential clinical benefits of interventions focused on socio-emotional regulation training.";;;;;;;;Este trabajo fue apoyado por subvenciones de la Comisión Nacional de Investigación Científica y Tecnológica (ANID/FONDECYT Regular N°1231117 a David Huepe.;;;;;;;;;;;;;BMC Psychology

column6: the neural reserve function would be the most relevant and best predictor of aspects related to social cognition and executive functions. We suggest that variables such as fluid and crystallized intelligence influence social cognition and executive functions. Results show that elderly people with high intelligence—mainly fluid intelligence—have better executive functions
column7: emotional recognition and theory of mind. This study is the first preliminary research to present a relationship between cognitive reserve and social cognition factors in elderly subjects. column2: Constanza;;;;;;;;Germany;;;;;;13-05-2026 11:48;;;2026-05-13T15:48:45Z;;2026-05-11;;;;"Background: Overweight and obesity are associated with reduced fertility outcomes in assisted reproduction. This scoping review maps available evidence on pre-IVF weight management interventions.

column1: Methods: We searched PubMed/MEDLINE (2008–2025) for studies evaluating weight management interventions (dietary
column4: surgical) before or during IVF in women with BMI ? 25 kg/m². We included randomized controlled trials
column5: quasi-xperimental studies
column6: and cohorts with interventions. Two reviewers independently screened records and extracted data on interventions and outcomes. Supplementary searches included reference screening and citation tracking.

column1: Results: From 230 records
column2: 19 studies met inclusion criteria: 17 evaluating IVF-specific outcomes — lifestyle or dietary interventions (n = 10)
column4: and bariatric surgery (n = 4) — and 2 examining preconception interventions before other ART modalities included exclusively to inform implementation challenges. Weight loss was achieved across intervention categories
column5: though the magnitude varied substantially. Improvements in reproductive outcomes were inconsistent. Some studies reported improved pregnancy rates following lifestyle interventions
column6: while well-designed trials showed no significant differences despite weight reduction. Orlistat showed no reproductive benefit; GLP-1 agonist combination therapy showed preliminary promise in PCOS. Bariatric surgery

column1: produced substantial weight loss but inconsistent live birth outcomes. High attrition rates (> 20%)
column3: and variable adherence were common challenges.

column1: Conclusions: Pre-IVF weight management interventions demonstrate substantial outcome heterogeneity. While weight loss is achievable
column2: reproductive benefits are inconsistent. Evidence does not support rigid BMI cutoffs. Clinical decisions should be individualized. Future research should identify predictive factors and optimize intervention protocols.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Middle East Fertility Society Journal

column2: Enrique;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;03-04-2023 9:12;;;03-04-2023 9:12;;2021-02;;;;;;Statement of problem. Dental publications worldwide have reported discrepancies between how removable partial dentures are taught at undergraduate level and how these clinical procedures are performed extramurally

The aims of this study are to evaluate the presence of mouth preparation (cingulum and/or occlusal rest seats) before fabrication of cast removable partial dentures and explore causes that may contribute to and result in discrepancies between what is taught at undergraduate level and what is later on practiced by qualified dentists. The tested null hypothesis was that there is no difference between the frequency of working casts with and without rest seat preparations evaluated by dental laboratories in our study. Material and Methods. 103 laboratories were identified through an internet search strategy. Each laboratory was subsequently telephoned to determine if they provided cast metal removable partial dentures. Only 36 laboratories were shortlisted and out of these only 24 agreed to take part in our study. Three establishments did not fulfil our inclusion criteria leaving an overall 21 dental laboratories to participate in this study. Laboratory staff were calibrated to inspect

All 21 calibrated laboratories were given a proforma spreadsheet to record the presence or absence of at least one rest seat preparation per model before fabrication of metal frameworks.Statistical analysis was performed with StataCorp softwareby using the binomial probability test of 1 sample. Results. A total of 1
column6: 512 working casts were inspected and 630 (41.70%)displayed rest seat preparations(P< 0.001). The remainder 58.30% of casts examined (882) had no rest seat preparations. Only two laboratories recorded over 80% of casts with rest seat preparations and eight laboratories recorded rest seat preparations in 20% of working casts
column7: or less. Conclusions. Lack of rest seat preparation highlights a rather large proportion of dentists performing inadequate mouth preparation before removable partial denture fabrication. column1: Objetivo: Comprender la percepción y significado que le otorgan los tutores clínicos al rol que ejercen con los estudiantes de enfermería que se encuentran en la etapa final de formación de pregrado cursando su internado hospitalario.

column1: Objective: To understand the perception and meaning given by clinical tutors to the role they play with nursing students who are in the final stage of their undergraduate training during their hospital internship.
Design: Qualitative design with a descriptive phenomenological approach.
Methods: Evaluator with partial immersion
column2: participants selected according to inclusion/exclusion criteria; the sample was heterogeneous; data collection was carried out until saturation. Data collection was by semi-structured interview validated by experts; analysis by Colaizzi and validation with participants.

column1: Results: A total of seven nurses participated in the study. Seven categories and twenty-one major themes emerged from the analysis. Concepts such as motivation and consent to be a tutor; characteristics such as responsibility
column2: empathy and trust; responsibilities associated with the role such as knowledge transfer
column4: putting theory into practice and learning to ""be a nurse"" stand out as achievements associated with the student. Warning signs appear
column5: such as previous bad experiences
column6: lived both by students in previous internships and by tutors in their undergraduate stage
column7: which determine the development of the process.

column1: Discussions and conclusions: Mentoring involves conveying to students what it is to ""be a nurse
column3: not just technical mastery. Tutors seek to change past negative experiences and avoid repeating patterns. Workload is recognized as a factor that hinders mentoring

column2: Marcelo;;;;;;;;;;;;;;17-12-2024 15:19;;;2024-12-17T18:19:20Z;;2024-01-03;;;;"Introduction: Degenerative Lumbar spinal stenosis (DLSS) is the most common cause of spine surgery for patients above 55 years. Surgery options include decompression alone or with spinal fusion. The DRG system uses classification algorithms that categorize patients into groups with similar clinical and resource consumption characteristics
column3: using ICD-10 nomenclature for diagnoses and ICD-9-CM for procedures.

column1: Objective: Identify clinical and epidemiological variables of DLSS surgery patients based on Chile’s DRG system data and define factors associated with arthrodesis as a complement to decompression.
Study Design: Retrospective observational study.

Methods: This study used the national DRG database to analyze factors predicting the need for fusion in patients with DLSS. Data from 31 public hospitals in Chile were analyzed for patients discharged between 2020 and 2022. Variables considered included age
column4: and attending physician specialty. For the descriptive analysis of qualitative variables
column5: frequencies and percentages were used.The study used univariate and multivariate logistic regression analysis. A statistical significance level of less than 0.05 was considered. Results: We analyzed 1024 patients with lumbar spinal stenosis and found that 54.6% were female and 45.4% were male (p= 0.0034). The majority of the patients (57.4%) were aged between 60 and 79 years. 75% of orthopedic surgeons opted for decompression plus arthrodesis
column6: while neurosurgeons preferred decompression alone in 73% of cases. The most significant predictors for decompression with fusion were the physician’s specialty in orthopedic surgery
column7: female sex
column8: and the presence of other spinal pathologies such as scoliosis
column9: herniated disc
column10: and spondylolisthesis. Patients treated by an Orthopedic Surgeon had an 8.2 times greater probability of undergoing decompression plus arthrodesis as compared to those treated by a Neurosurgeon. Additionally
column11: the presence of spondylolisthesis increased the probability of decompression with fusion by 6.2 times
column12: and the presence of scoliosis increased it by 6.6 times. Neurosurgeons opted for decompression alone in 89.7% of the cases with DLSS stenosis and herniated disc
column13: while only 48.9% of orthopedic surgeons opted for the same option (p=0.0000).

column1: Conclusion: Our study based on DRG records from public hospitals in Chile has identified certain factors linked to a higher frequency of spinal arthrodesis. These factors include the surgery being performed by orthopedic surgeons
column2: patients aged between 40 and 60 years old
column3: the presence of degenerative spondylolisthesis and degenerative scoliosis
column4: and the absence of a herniated disc.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Archives of Epidemiology

Various interventions in anterior maxillary region such as implant placement, extractions, installation of orthodontic microscrews, surgical procedures, among others, can compromise the Canalis sinuosus and/or its accessory canals, damaging the elements contained inside, causing complications such as bleeding, paresthesia, dysesthesia, etc. Given the great ignorance of its existence, Canalis sinuosus is frequently confused with pathological and/or endodontic lesions. Classically, the literature describes it as an anatomical variation, however, it presents high prevalence (51.7 %-100 %), this assertion being questioned. Objective: to determine the prevalence and anatomical characteristics of Canalis sinuosus using Cone Beam CT in Chilean patients from the IMAPROX® radiological center between 2017-2021. Retrospective analysis of 220 anonymous maxillary CBCT, considering variables sex, presence of Canalis sinuosus, uni/bilateral Canalis sinuosus, largest diameter of Canalis sinuosus, presence/number of accessory canals. Univariate and bivariate statistical analysis. The 100 % prevalence of Canalis sinuosus in both sexes, 100 % bilateral presence. Canalis sinuosus average major diameter: 2.58 mm, 76.8 % presented accessory canals, with the presence of 2 accessory canals being more prevalent (34.1 %). A habitual normal anatomical structure must have a prevalence of over 50 % to be considered as such, but there is no consensus on the criteria used to define anatomical variation or normal anatomical structure. Literature describes Canalis sinuosus as anatomical variation, but current studies show high prevalence: Russia 67 %, Brazil 88 %, Turkey, Colombia and Chile 100 %. This study found 100 % prevalence, suggesting that Canalis sinuosus is an normal anatomical structure. However, Canalis sinuosus is little known as it is associated with numerous complications from dental and/or surgical procedures in anterior maxillary region, which can cause bleeding, paresthesia/dysesthesia, acute pain, etc. High reported prevalences suggest that Canalis sinuosus is an normal anatomical structure and not an anatomical variation, but more studies and consensus are required to confirm this. column6: guided by a planned user program code

This paper argues that the problem has been systematically misframed rather than properly resolved. Instability does not arise from the holistic relation between meaning and belief as such
column3: but from a metasemantic underarticulation of the role of contextual constraint in both human and technologically mediated interpretation. While Henry Jackman’s moderate holism mitigates traditional indeterminacy through a many-to-one mapping between beliefs and meanings
column4: it leaves unexplained how the range of admissible interpretations is effectively constrained across heterogeneous communicative settings. In the present framework
column5: context is understood not merely as a pragmatic background
column6: but as a structured set of inferential
column7: interactional
column8: and institutionally reinforced constraints that delimit which interpretative trajectories remain interpretatively sustainable within a given environment. This broader notion of context differs from narrowly pragmatic forms of contextualism while remaining compatible with inferential and interactional approaches developed in contemporary philosophy of language (cf. Stalnaker 1999; Recanati 2004). On this view
column9: semantic stability emerges from constrained interpretative selection governed by contextual pressures operating across heterogeneous communicative environments. The term “metasemantic” is used here not only in the classical sense of determining semantic facts
column10: but more specifically to designate higher-order constraints governing interpretative admissibility across heterogeneous communicative environments. Building on Donald Davidson’s later reflections on passing theories
column11: the paper develops a form of contextualist holism in which context functions as a metasemantic regulator of interpretative space. Through analyses of translation
column12: intralinguistic variation
column13: and AI-mediated interpretation
column14: the article shows that stability can persist under conditions of deep epistemic heterogeneity when contextual regulation remains sufficiently operative. Particular attention is given to AI-mediated interpretation
column15: where systems frequently generate contextually successful interpretations without relying on shared belief structures or stable human conceptual backgrounds. This makes artificial systems especially revealing cases for understanding how semantic coordination can emerge through contextual regulation rather than through epistemic convergence. By reframing stability as a problem of constrained interpretative selection rather than belief persistence
column16: contextualist holism provides a more explicit and operational account of how semantic variability and stability coexist.";;;;;;;12-08-2027;;;;;;;;;;;;;;AI & SOCIETY

column1: Methods: A prospective observational study was conducted over five months in an 18-bed medical-surgical ICU at a tertiary-level hospital in Spain. All admitted patients were included. column5: followed by dose adjustment for underdosing or insufficient duration (18.00%)
column6: therapeutic drug monitoring recommendations (10.67%)
column7: and drug information to clinical staff (6.66%).

column1: Conclusions: CCPs identify a substantial number of antimicrobial-related drug problems in the ICU through routine prospective review. column1: Aim: To analyse the implementation process and outcomes of a nurse-led hospital-wide recycling programme initiated in the intensive care unit of a Latin American tertiary-care hospital.

column2: quantitative analysis of recycling volumes and direct observations of operational practices across multiple hospital departments.

column1: Results: The programme established recycling protocols while maintaining infection control standards. Total recycled materials increased from 44?994?kg in 2019 (3% of total waste) to a peak of 102?579?kg in 2021
column2: with subsequent decline to 48?279?kg in 2023. Despite this decline
column3: recycling rates remained above baseline (4.7%–5.8% vs. 0.2% pre-implementation). Material distribution showed organic waste (59.1%) and paper/cardboard (36.4%) as primary components. Key implementation challenges included space constraints
column4: staff engagement variability and absence of standardised frameworks
column5: addressed through protocol adaptation
column6: education programmes and waste collection optimisation.

column1: Conclusions: This case study suggests that implementing comprehensive recycling programmes in middle-income healthcare settings may be feasible despite resource limitations when protocols are adapted to local contexts and clinical leadership is leveraged.

column1: Results: We found 1873 articles. A total of 64 articles were reviewed
column2: identifying 31 radiological classification systems. We found 7 classifications for degenerative disc disease

column5: 8 for degenerative spinal stenosis

column1: Discussion: Reliability studies play a crucial role in evaluating a classification system as they enable reproducibility among evaluators
column2: thereby fortifying the system. Classifications should not only be endorsed based on their validation and reliability studies
column3: but it is also crucial to assess their feasibility for practical implementation in clinical settings.

column9: and thus are also applicable to EPS in order to enable and maintain a sustainable performance when EPS are linked to energy efficiency (EE) and thriftiness. In doing so
column10: both reactive and predictive homeostasis play a substantive role in the engineering of such mechanisms. Reactive homeostasis (RH) is an immediate response of the SES to a homeostatic challenge such as energy deprivation

column12: reestablishing homeostasis or efficient equilibrium in the system. Predictive homeostasis (PH)
column13: on the other hand

column1: Skeletal muscle generates force and movements and maintains posture. Under pathological conditions

column4: our laboratory described secondary sarcopenia in a chronic cholestatic liver disease (CCLD) mouse model. Interestingly
column5: the administration of ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA)
column6: a hydrophilic bile acid
column7: is an effective therapy for cholestatic hepatic alterations. However
column8: the effect of UDCA on skeletal muscle mass and functionality has never been evaluated

We assessed the ability of UDCA to generate sarcopenia in C57BL6 mice and develop a sarcopenic-like phenotype in C2C12 myotubes and isolated muscle fibers. In mice
column2: we measured muscle strength by a grip strength test
column3: muscle mass by bioimpedance and mass for specific muscles
column4: and physical function by a treadmill test. We also detected the fiber's diameter and content of sarcomeric proteins. In C2C12 myotubes and/or isolated muscle fibers
column5: we determined the diameter and troponin I level to validate the cellular effect. Moreover
column6: to evaluate possible mechanisms
column7: we detected puromycin incorporation
column8: p70S6K
column9: and 4EBP1 to evaluate protein synthesis and ULK1
column10: LC3 I
column11: and II protein levels to determine autophagic flux. The mitophagosome-like structures were detected by transmission electron microscopy.

column1: Results
UDCA induced sarcopenia in healthy mice
column4: and physical function
column5: with a decline in the fiber's diameter and the troponin I protein levels. In the C2C12 myotubes
column6: we observed that UDCA caused a reduction in the diameter and content of MHC
column7: troponin I
column8: puromycin incorporation
column9: and phosphorylated forms of p70S6K and 4EBP1. Further
column10: we detected increased levels of phosphorylated ULK1
column11: the LC3II/LC3I ratio
column12: and the number of mitophagosome-like structures. These data suggest that UDCA induces a sarcopenic-like phenotype with decreased protein synthesis and autophagic flux.

column1: Conclusions

Our results indicate that UDCA induces sarcopenia in mice and sarcopenic-like features in C2C12 myotubes and/or isolated muscle fibers concomitantly with decreased protein synthesis and alterations in autophagic flux.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Biological Research

column6: no colágenas y complejos proteoglicanos - glicosaminoglicanos (PGs-GAGs). Ésta se modifica bioquímica y estructuralmente durante el ciclo de vida de una pieza dentaria. Una de las modificaciones más importantes es la transparentación de la matriz dentinaria inducida por la obliteración o esclerosis de los túbulos dentinarios.

column1: El propósito de este trabajo de investigación
column2: es determinar la alteración de los complejos PGs-GAGs intratubulares en la dentina transparente radicular. Para tal efecto
column3: se utilizarán piezas dentarias sanas libres de caries
column4: extraídas por mal pronóstico periodontal o protésico (N=10) y 5 premolares extraídos por indicación protésica de pacientes entre 15 a 18 años con formación radicular completa. Se realizarán cortes transversales mineralizados de 1 mm de espesor desde el borde incisal o superficie oclusal hasta el ápice anatómico. Los cortes se acondicionarÁn con ácido ortofosfórico al 37% durante 30 segundos
column5: para posteriormente ser incubados en una solución de Alcian Blue 8gx al 1%
column6: en ácido acético 0
column7: 1% durante 12 hrs a temperatura ambiente.

column1: Los cortes serán observados mediante microscopia estereoscópica por epiiluminación y las imágenes se almacenarán como archivo JPEG. Se observó
column2: que independientemente de la edad de los individuos
column3: la dentina radicular se transparenta progresivamente desde el límite amelocementario hasta el ápice anatómico de las piezas dentarias estudiadas. La tinción histoquímica demostró una reactividad positiva en las zonas de dentina opaca y una reactividad negativa en las zonas de dentina transparente.

column1: Se concluye que la transparentación dentinaria se relaciona con una modificación o pérdida de los proteoglicanos intratubulares. Al igual que en otros sistemas biológicos

column3: little empirical evidence exists regarding the relationship between social contact and social adaptation. We propose that loneliness and social networks are key factors explaining social adaptation. Sixty-four healthy subjects with no history of psychiatric conditions participated in this study. All participants completed self-report questionnaires about loneliness
column4: social network
column5: and social adaptation. On a separate day
column6: subjects underwent a resting state fMRI recording session. A hierarchical regression model on self-report data revealed that loneliness and social network were negatively and positively associated with social adaptation. Functional connectivity (FC) analysis showed that loneliness was associated with decreased FC between the fronto-amygdalar and fronto-parietal regions. In contrast
column7: the social network was positively associated with FC between the fronto-temporo-parietal network. Finally
column8: an integrative path model examined the combined effects of behavioral and brain predictors of social adaptation. The model revealed that social networks mediated the effects of loneliness on social adaptation. Further
column9: loneliness-related abnormal brain FC (previously shown to be associated with difficulties in cognitive control
column10: emotion regulation
column11: and sociocognitive processes) emerged as the strongest predictor of poor social adaptation. Findings offer insights into the brain indicators of social adaptation and highlight the role of social networks as a buffer against the maladaptive effects of loneliness. These findings can inform interventions aimed at minimizing loneliness and promoting social adaptation and are especially relevant due to the high prevalence of loneliness around the globe. These findings also serve the study of social adaptation since they provide potential neurocognitive factors that could influence social adaptation.;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Scientific Reports

column1: Methods a concurrent multicenter observational study was performed
column2: analyzing clinical variables and pulmonary mechanics of PARDS associated with COVID-19 in 4 Pediatric intensive care units (PICUs) of Perú. Subgroup analysis included PARDS associated with multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C)
column4: and PARDS with COVID-19 primary respiratory infection
column5: C-PARDS. In addition
column6: receiver operator curve analysis (ROC) for mortality was performed.

column1: Results 30 patients were included. Age was 7.5(4-11) years
column3: and mortality 23%. 47% corresponded to MIS-PARDS and 53% to C-PARDS phenotypes. C-PARDS had positive RT-PCR in 67% and MIS-PARDS none (p<0.001). C-PARDS group had more profound hypoxemia (P/Fratio<100
column5: p<0.01) and higher driving-pressure (DP) [14(10-22)vs10(10-12)cmH2O]
column6: and lower compliance of the respiratory system (CRS)[0.5(0.3-0.6)vs 0.7(0.6-0.8)ml/kg/cmH2O] compared to MIS-PARDS (all p<0.05). ROC-analysis for mortality showed that DP had the best performance [AUC 0.91(95%CI0.81-1.00)
column7: with the best cut-point of 15 cmH2O (100% sensitivity and 87% of specificity). Mortality in C-PARDS was 38% and 7% in MIS-PARDS(p=0.09). MV free-days were 12(0-23) in C-PARDS and 23(21-25) in MIS-PARDS(p=0.02)

column1: Conclusion critical pediatric COVID-19 is heterogeneous in children. COVID-19 PARDS had two phenotypes with distinctive pulmonary mechanics features. Characteristics of C-PARDS are like a classic primary PARDS
column2: while a decoupling between compliance and hypoxemia was more frequent in MIS-PARDS. In addition
column3: C-PARDS had fewer MV free-days. DP ? 15 cmH2O had the best performance of the quasi-static calculations to discriminate for mortality.
