column1: El presente proyecto tiene como objetivo desarrollar un proceso industrial que permita reutilizar residuos textiles como materia prima para la fabricación de muebles
column2: aportando a la reducción de desechos y fomentando la economía circular. Para ello
column3: se realizó un análisis del consumo y la producción textil a nivel mundial
column4: del impacto medioambiental de esta industria y del ingreso de ropa usada a Chile. Además
column5: se caracterizaron los desechos textiles disponibles
column6: se evaluaron las tecnologías necesarias para su procesamiento y se analizó la viabilidad económica de su reutilización.

column1: This essay addresses the concept of death
column2: recognizing that it is understood in different ways across various religions and cultures around the world. What in some traditions is conceived as an ending
column3: in others appears as a transition. The analysis centers on questioning the negative conception of death that prevails in Western society
column4: a view historically shaped by Christian religious beliefs and reinforced by broader sociocultural influences. With the aim of challenging and transforming this perspective
column5: the study incorporates the Eastern conception of death
column6: proposing a reinterpretation based on this worldview. In Eastern cultures
column7: death is not necessarily regarded as an absolute end
column8: but rather as part of a cyclical process of transmutation that begins again. From this standpoint
column9: the artistic research developed through crochet techniques
column10: formal exploration
column11: and the constructive process articulated through the sculptural work with wire seeks to embody the notion of transformation and infinity in both visual and material terms. The resulting work invites viewers to engage with death as a form of change rather than a definitive ending
column12: fostering a symbolic and reflective experience.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12254/7600;;;;spa;;;;;;Universidad Finis Terrae (Chile) Facultad de Artes;;;;;;;;;;;;Acceso abierto;;Atribución-NoComercial-CompartirIgual 3.0 Chile (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 CL);https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/3.0/cl/;;;;;;;;;Muerte||Cultura||Transformación||Ciclo;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;La muerte : la idea de lo infinito como elemento de la existencia;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Thesis;http://purl.org/coar/resource_type/c_46ec;;;;;;;;;;;;;

column2: Alejandra;;;;;;;;United Kingdom;;;;;;23-02-2026 14:47;;;2026-02-23T17:47:20Z;;2025-02;;;;"Background: Primary aldosteronism (PA) is the main cause of secondary arterial hypertension. In this study
column3: we present the medical treatment of Hispanic patients with PA followed for up to 5 years
column4: highlighting the complete cure with pharmacological treatment in one of our patients.

column1: Methods: We studied 32 PA patients
column2: followed every 6 months after starting MRA. A clinical response was the normalization of blood pressure (BP) in the absence of other antihypertensive drugs. The biochemical response was considered with normalization of potassium and renin. Responses to treatment were compared using the defined daily dose (DDD). The effect of MRA was evaluated in vitro. The HAC15 cells were cultured and stimulated with aldosterone and spironolactone for 24-72 h
column3: and the apoptotic cell death was measured.

column1: Results: At 12 months posttreatment with MRA
column2: 68% of the patients had a total clinical response
column3: and 67% had a total biochemical response. Response to MRA treatment reduced DDD by an average of 74%. Additionally
column4: we observed one PA patient treated with spironolactone after 3 years
column5: he presented a pharmacological cure with normalization of aldosterone and renin without treatment with spironolactone. The in vitro study shows that spironolactone increased early apoptosis by 60% and late apoptosis by 50%.

column1: Conclusions: These results suggest the importance of timely diagnosis of PA and specific treatment with MRA
column2: especially in patients with a poor response to treatment. Moreover
column3: remission of PA may occur in some patients after spironolactone treatment due to its suggestive role as an apoptotic agent.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;American Journal of Hypertension

column6: año 2024;Con la llegada de la pandemia en el año 2020
column7: el comercio electrónico en Chile comenzó a tener más importancia
column8: puesto que
column9: la necesidad de seguir comprando en los consumidores nunca cesó. Sin embargo
column10: comenzaron a surgir distintos conflictos entre proveedores y consumidores
column11: en materia de incumplimiento del contrato de compraventa electrónica. Esto dejó en evidencia una total desprotección en los consumidores por el desconocimiento de sus derechos y por la falta de regulación especial sobre esta “nueva forma” de comercio. No obstante
column12: el 23 de septiembre del 2021
column13: se publicó en el Diario Oficial
column14: el Decreto N°6 que aprueba el reglamento de comercio electrónico
column15: llegando a complementar la Ley N°19.496 sobre protección de los derechos de los consumidores. El objetivo de este trabajo fue estudiar y analizar
column16: después de la entrada en vigor del nuevo reglamento sobre comercio electrónico
column17: qué es lo que establece nuestro ordenamiento jurídico y la jurisprudencia para la resolución de conflictos por el incumplimiento de contratos de compraventas electrónicas. Además
column18: se estudian los derechos de los consumidores y las obligaciones de los proveedores en este tipo de contratos e incluimos un análisis de las directivas de la Unión Europea
column19: en especial la legislación española en cuanto al tema. Con lo anterior
column20: demostramos que en Chile aún tenemos deficiencias que se deben mejorar con una regulación más exhaustiva para la debida protección a los derechos de los consumidores en el comercio electrónico. Esto es
column21: debido a que el entorno digital va en constante evolución
column22: y
column23: en la práctica se exige que nuestro país se adapte y busque un equilibrio para promover la innovación y el crecimiento del comercio electrónico
column24: salvaguardando siempre los derechos de los consumidores.;;"""With the arrival of the pandemic in 2020
column25: e-commerce in Chile began to have more importance
column26: since consumers' need to continue buying never ceased. However
column27: various conflicts began to arise between suppliers and consumers regarding non-compliance with the electronic sales contract. This revealed a total lack of protection among consumers due to the lack of knowledge of their rights and the lack of special regulation on this “new form” of commerce. However
column28: on September 23
column30: Decree No. 6 was published in the Official Gazette
column31: which approves the electronic commerce regulations
column32: complementing Law No. 19
column33: 496 on the protection of consumer rights. The objective of this work was to study and analyze
column34: after the entry into force of the new regulations on electronic commerce
column35: what our legal system and jurisprudence establishes for the resolution of conflicts due to non-compliance with electronic sales contracts. In addition
column36: the rights of consumers and the obligations of suppliers in this type of contracts are studied and we include an analysis of the directives of the European Union
column37: especially Spanish legislation on the subject. With the above

column2: Mauricio;;;;;;;;;;;;;;28-11-2024 11:59;;;2024-11-28T14:59:43Z;;2023-07-01;;;;Mitochondria-endoplasmic/sarcoplasmic reticulum (ER/SR) interaction and mitochondrial fusion/fission are critical processes that influence substrate oxidation. column3: a decrease in mitochondria-SR interaction and an increase in mitochondrial fission are associated with an elevated glycolytic activity. Based on the evidence reviewed
column4: we postulate two hypotheses for the link between mitochondrial dynamics and insulin resistance in human skeletal muscle. First
column5: glucose and fatty acid availability modifies mitochondria-SR interaction and mitochondrial fusion/fission to help the cell to adapt substrate oxidation appropriately. Individuals with an impaired response to these substrate challenges will accumulate lipid species and develop insulin resistance in skeletal muscle. Second
column6: a chronically elevated substrate availability (e.g. overfeeding) increases mitochondrial production of reactive oxygen species and induced mitochondrial fission. This decreases fatty acid oxidation
column7: thus leading to the accumulation of lipid species and insulin resistance in skeletal muscle. Altogether
column8: we propose mitochondrial dynamics as a potential target for disturbances associated with low fatty acid oxidation.;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Metabolism

column5: 2024;"El tratamiento endodóntico es un procedimiento técnico y desafiante que representa un reto importante para los odontólogos en su práctica clínica cotidiana. Se espera que los estudiantes de odontología
column6: al finalizar su formación
column7: cuenten con las habilidades necesarias para realizar diagnósticos precisos y desarrollar planes de tratamiento efectivos y seguros. Sin embargo
column8: muchos graduados sienten que no están suficientemente capacitados para realizar tratamientos endodónticos con confianza debido a la complejidad de los factores involucrados. Esta falta de seguridad está fuertemente relacionada con la percepción que tienen tanto los estudiantes como los docentes sobre la calidad de la educación en el área de Endodoncia.

column1: Objetivo: Evaluar el nivel de confianza en la realización de tratamientos de conducto y la percepción sobre la calidad educativa en endodoncia en estudiantes de 4to
column3: así como en docentes de la Universidad Finis Terrae durante el año 2024.

column1: Materiales y métodos: Estudio observacional descriptivo y transversal. La muestra estuvo compuesta por 187 participantes
column3: 5to y 6to año de odontología y docentes de la Universidad Finis Terrae
column4: año 2024. Se analizaron cuatro variables: el nivel de confianza al realizar procedimientos endodónticos
column5: la percepción sobre la calidad de la educación en endodoncia
column6: nivel académico y género. La investigación fue aprobada por el Comité de Ética Científica de la universidad Finis Terrae N°21-051
column7: y se solicitó el consentimiento informado de los participantes. El instrumento utilizado fue un cuestionario previamente validado por J. Davey et al. en el Reino Unido
column8: adaptado a la Universidad de Cardiff
column9: el cual fue traducido y validado para el contexto latinoamericano por A. Valdez (6).

column1: Resultados: Los estudiantes de 6º año evidenciaron mayor confianza en procedimientos endodónticos básicos
column2: mientras que los de 4º y 5º año presentaron menor seguridad en etapas técnicas complejas como la obturación y la determinación de longitud de trabajo. Los docentes reportaron altos niveles de confianza en procedimientos generales y una percepción positiva de la formación en endodoncia.

column1: Conclusión: La confianza en endodoncia aumenta con la experiencia clínica

column2: Iñigo;;;;;;;;;;;;;;17-07-2025 15:50;;;2025-07-17T19:50:39Z;;2025-04-08;;;;"Sport-physiology and -performance research often relies on group designs that compare experimental and control groups and/or preintervention and postintervention results. This commentary highlights the key elements of a high-quality case study and provides clear guidelines for readers and authors of the International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance. We propose 4 essential components. First
column3: case studies should offer relevant and original insights by tackling novel issues and defining a clear purpose. Second
column4: they must employ rigorous methodology
column5: encompassing careful participant selection
column6: comprehensive data

column1: collection from diverse sources (eg
column4: physiological tests
column5: training diaries
column6: competition data)
column7: and deliberate data analysis that explicitly addresses factors influencing performance changes. Third
column8: they should be well structured and engagingly presented to reach both academic and practical audiences. Finally
column9: bridging the science–practice gap is vital
column10: requiring and strengthening collaboration between researchers and practitioners to enable data-driven decision making and spark new hypotheses. Conclusions: Although case studies traditionally rank low in the research evidence hierarchy
column11: high-quality examples can significantly bridge the gap between research and practice. By working closely with the sporting community and strategically sharing findings
column12: case studies can enhance evidence-based training strategies and amplify the real-world impact of sport science.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;International Journal of Sports Physiology and Performance

column7: and hand grip strength was 26.52%

column6: 2023;;;"Background: Non-carious cervical lesions (NCCL) are defects at the cementoenamel junction (CEJ) of the tooth and constitute a prevalent chief complaint. Dentin is the main mineralized component of the tooth structure
column7: its tubules mineralize as a consequence of ageing
column8: increasing its translucency. A morphological description of NCCLs from a histological and anatomopathological point of view is currently scarce. Is important to recognize the morphology and composition of the NCCL’s dentin in the restorative treatments planning.

column1: Objectives: Histologically analyze the dentinal translucency present in NCCLs through microscopic observation and the digital characterization of the dentinal types of NCCLs using colour thresholding analysis.
Method:  Forty-four specimens with NCCLs were analyzed after axial mesiodistal abrasion
column2: observed over a black background by means of epi illumination microscopy. The dentin was analyzed using the Threshold Colour plug-in for the ImageJ software.

column1: Results: The dentin translucency was expressed histologically as transparent (41%)
column4: affected by Maillard reaction (84%)
column5: and altered by antibiotic intake (11%).

column1: Discussion and conclusion: NCCLs are heterogeneous entities in which the dentinal translucency levels present a different distribution among each specimen.";;"Antecedentes: Las lesiones cervicales no cariosas (LCNC) son defectos de la estructura dental en el límite amelocementario (LAC) y motivo de consulta prevalente. La dentina es el tejido dentario más abundante
column2: sus túbulos se biomineralizan producto del envejecimiento aumentando su translucidez. La descripción morfológica de las LCNC desde una perspectiva histológica y anatomopatológica es actualmente escasa. Es importante reconocer la morfología y composición dentinaria de las LCNC para planificar tratamientos restauradores.

column1: Objetivos: Analizar histológicamente la translucidez dentinaria en LCNC a través de observaciones microscópicas y caracterizar digitalmente los tipos de dentina en LCNC mediante análisis de umbral de color.

Materiales y métodos:  Se analizaron 44 especímenes con LCNC mediante desgastes mesiodistales en el eje axial que fueron observados sobre fondo negro mediante microscopía de epi-iluminación. Se analizó digitalmente la dentina mediante el plug-in Threshold Colour para ImageJ.
Resultados: La translucidez de la dentina se expresó histológicamente como dentina transparente (41%)
column4: afectada por la reacción de Maillard (84%) y en dentina con alteraciones por la ingesta de antibióticos (11%).

column1: Discusiones y conclusiones: Las LCNC son entidades heterogéneas en las cuales los niveles de translucidez dentinaria presentan distinta distribución en cada espécimen.

column1: Chile's aging population presents a challenge to its pension system. Chile has very low pensions: half of pensions paid out are below the poverty line
column2: and women are worse off than men. This worries young people
column3: despite their tendency to 'live in the present'. Through semi-structured interviews
column4: this qualitative study explores the way young Chilean women between 20 and 35 years of age (both professional and nonprofessional) perceive the pension system and strategize ways of supporting themselves economically in old age. The results show a negative perception of the pension system and widely shared doubt that women will be able to rely on their pensions in order to maintain a decent standard of living in old age. It also discusses the fact that young women do not mention gender differences within the pension system
column5: despite clear awareness of socioeconomic inequalities and their impacts on pensions. Regarding retirement strategies
column6: the idea of saving is more common than its actual practice
column7: including investment in real estate to compliment low pensions. The paper concludes that there is widespread discontent about pensions and retirement as well as a focus on the present
column8: both of which affect saving practices. This varies according to educational level and family conformation. column6: año 2024;"El presente trabajo de tesis analiza la implementación del Acuerdo de Escazú en Chile
column7: un tratado internacional clave para América Latina y el Caribe
column8: centrado en garantizar el acceso a la información
column9: la participación pública y el acceso a la justicia en asuntos ambientales. Dada la reciente ratificación del acuerdo por parte de Chile en 2022
column10: en esta investigación se planteó la siguiente pregunta: ¿Cuál es el estado actual y los desafíos de la implementación del Acuerdo de Escazú en Chile?

column1: Para abordar esta cuestión
column2: se realizó un análisis cualitativo de la normativa ambiental vigente en Chile
column3: contrastándola con los compromisos internacionales adquiridos con la ratificación del Acuerdo. Además
column4: se identificaron los principales desafíos políticos
column5: legales y operativos que enfrenta el país en este proceso de implementación.

column1: Las conclusiones de la investigación subrayan que
column2: aunque Chile ha demostrado un compromiso firme con la protección ambiental a través de marcos legales robustos
column3: aún enfrenta significativos obstáculos en la plena implementación del Acuerdo de Escazú. Estos incluyen la necesidad de mayor armonización legislativa
column4: fortalecimiento institucional y la asignación de recursos financieros adecuados. Sin embargo
column5: se reconocen también oportunidades importantes para avanzar en la sostenibilidad ambiental y la participación democrática en el país
column6: si se superan estos desafíos.";;"This thesis analyses the implementation of the Escazu Agreement in Chile
column7: a key international treaty for Latin America and the Caribbean
column8: focused on guaranteeing access to information
column9: public participation and access to justice in environmental matters. Given Chile's recent ratification of the agreement in 2022
column10: this research posed the following question: What is the current status and challenges of the implementation of the Escazú Agreement in Chile?

column1: To address this question
column2: a qualitative analysis of Chile's current environmental regulations was carried out
column3: contrasting them with the international commitments acquired with the ratification of the Agreement. In addition
column4: the main political
column5: legal and operational challenges faced by the country in this implementation process were identified.

column1: The research findings underline that
column2: although Chile has demonstrated a firm commitment to environmental protection through robust legal frameworks
column3: it still faces significant obstacles in the full implementation of the Escazú Agreement. These include the need for further legislative harmonisation
column4: institutional strengthening and the allocation of adequate financial resources. However
column5: important opportunities for advancing environmental sustainability and democratic participation in the country are also recognised

column2: Sarat Kumar;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;06-09-2019 10:37;;;06-09-2019 10:37;;2018;;;;;Energy from the sun is harnessed through a photovoltaic (PV) array in form of DC. This available DC voltage is converted into AC for industrial or domestic use as per the requirement. In some topologies the extracted DC voltage is stepped up to a higher level of DC using a boost or a buck-boost converter and then this stepped up DC voltage is converted into AC by the use of an inverter. However this process is pretty costly because of the larger number of components employed. An efficient alternative to this two-stage approach is the Single-Stage Inverter (SSI). SSI does the boosting of DC and inversion of the DC to AC using only a single circuit and hence the name Single-Stage Boost Inverter. SSBI give us the advantage of reduced and robust circuitry along with reliability and efficiency. This paper presents a review of the various (however not all) SSI topologies in PV systems.;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews

column2: María Bernardita;;;;;;;;;;;;;;04-08-2025 9:00;;;2025-08-04T13:00:28Z;;2025-07-17;;;;"La exposición de las baldosas de Santiago examina el uso de pavimentos ornamentados a finales del siglo XIX y principios del XX en antiguos barrios de la ciudad de Santiago de Chile. La puesta en escena de esta investigación plantea un desafío en la representación de la arquitectura y los objetos materiales. La baldosa y los oficios que la acompañan se presentan físicamente
column3: con su textura y volumen accesible al espectador. Los inmuebles que contextualizaron su uso se trasladan a la exhibición mediante imágenes y recursos audiovisuales. La dirección fotográfica cumple un rol en la captura de la esencia de los espacios urbanos y arquitectónicos
column4: permitiendo al espectador reconstruir visualmente la relación entre el ornamento y la ciudad. La exposición se divide en seis grandes vitrinas que hacen de muro con un paseo acompañan al visitante y lo sumergen en la historia y las problemáticas urbanas de la época.

column1: La investigación plantea la problemática de la pérdida del patrimonio ornamental en Santiago de Chile
column3: debido al desarrollo urbano y la demolición de inmuebles antiguos. Estas baldosas
column4: presentes en diversos espacios públicos y privados durante más de un siglo
column5: son consideradas elementos esenciales en la configuración histórica y cultural de la ciudad. Asimismo
column6: busca valorar el diseño ornamental y el patrimonio histórico urbano de Santiago
column7: enfocándose en el análisis histórico y estético- funcional de las baldosas hidráulicas. El estudio realizó un inventario y clasificación de más de 150 diseños modulares
column8: paletas de colores y patrones de uso en barrios históricos como Santiago
column9: Providencia y Recoleta. La información recopilada se organizó según la tipología de uso
column10: abarcando desde aceras y espacios exteriores hasta viviendas
column11: espacios comerciales
column12: recintos hospitalarios y arquitectura moderna.

column1: Los resultados de la investigación se difundieron a través de una exposición temporal en el Centro Cultural Palacio de la Moneda. La muestra buscó generar una conexión emocional con el espectador
column2: destacando la importancia de preservar estos detalles ornamentales como parte integral del patrimonio urbano. Se enfatizó que el patrimonio no se limita a los inmuebles
column3: sino que reside también en los elementos ornamentales que evidencian procesos de diseño y fabricación semi artesanal.

column6: such as charity shops
column7: is limited. Therefore
column8: this study aims to understand the social behavior of stakeholders (managers
column9: sales assistants
column10: buyers
column11: and donors) who collaborate in a charity shop that uses CE strategies. To address this
column12: the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) and stakeholder theory were used. Furthermore
column13: the qualitative methodology of an exploratory case study was considered
column14: which incorporated semi-structured interviews with 12 stakeholders who participated in the Chilean COANIQUEM charity shop. The results indicate that these organizations
column15: through their different stakeholders with an environmental
column16: social
column17: and economic attitude
column18: interact with one another and promote behaviors that favor circular strategies of reusing
column19: recycling
column20: and sharing in charity shops. These findings contribute to the CE literature in nongovernmental organizations and the TPB perspective by analyzing the attitude construct.

Frente a este desafío, las organizaciones están implementando prácticas que controlan el consumo, reducen desechos y disminuyen el impacto negativo al medio ambiente, mediante estrategias que fomentan la Economía Circular (EC). Sin embargo, la literatura sobre la comprensión actual de las estrategias circulares en organizaciones no gubernamentales, como en las tiendas solidarias, es limitada. Por ello, el propósito de este estudio es comprender el comportamiento social de los stakeholders (administrador, asistentes de venta, compradores y donadores) a colaborar en una tienda solidaria que emplea estrategias de EC. Para abordar esto, se utilizó la Teoría de Comportamiento Planeado (TPB) y la teoría de stakeholders. Además, se consideró la metodología cualitativa de estudio de caso exploratorio que incorporó entrevistas semiestructuradas a doce stakeholders que participan en la tienda solidaria COANIQUEM chilena. Los resultados muestran que estas organizaciones, a través, de sus diferentes stakeholders con una actitud ambiental, social y económica, interactúan entre sí e impulsan comportamientos que favorecen las estrategias circulares de reutilizar, reciclar, y compartir, en las tiendas solidarias. column2: Carmen Gloria;;;;;;;;;;;;;;04-12-2024 9:07;;;2024-12-04T12:07:52Z;;2023-12;;;;"Introducción: La población de personas mayores que fallece producto del cáncer aumenta de manera sostenida a nivel mundial. Los cuidados paliativos suponen un abordaje integral que incluye cuidados espirituales. Estos son valorados por el paciente y cuidadores; pero es poco abordado en la práctica clínica.

column1: Objetivo: Establecer las condiciones obstaculizadoras que percibe el equipo de salud para proporcionar cuidado espiritual a personas mayores que se encuentran en cuidado paliativo

Métodos: Se realizó un estudio cualitativo con enfoque fenomenológico/interpretativo y diseño de estudio de caso intrínseco. Se realizó entrevista semiestructurada y grupos focales a un equipo de salud que se desempeña en la Unidad de  Cuidados Paliativos de un centro asistencial
column2: en Chile entre el 2019 y 2020. El análisis fue con enfoque de Teoría Fundamentada
column3: que permitieron proponer esquemas comprensivos del fenómeno de estudio con apoyo del programa Atlas-ti 9.0.

column1: Resultados: Se categorizaron dos condiciones obstaculizadoras
column2: una relacionada con el paciente y su familia
column3: y otra con aspectos estructurales institucionales y formativos. Existe una percepción de afrontamiento ineficaz hacia la  enfermedad por parte del paciente y su familia que se manifiesta por una negación hacia la muerte y que se acrecienta en aquellos que no profesan un credo. Además
column4: el énfasis científico de la formación y ausencia formativa en cuidado espiritual merma la motivación de los trabajadores para involucrarse.

column1: Conclusiones: Es necesario crear estrategias de incorporación de cuidado espiritual
column2: desde prácticas locales que se traduzcan en sistémicas; no obstante

column2: Nicole;;;;;;;;Switzerland;;;;;;06-01-2026 13:19;;;2026-01-06T16:19:09Z;;2025-10-31;;;;"Objectives: The aim of this study was to analyze the association between exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) up to six months and both nutritional status and eating behavior in Chilean

column1: schoolchildren aged 5 to 8 years.

Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted involving 109 children aged 8–10 years from three cities in Chile. EBF was assessed retrospectively through caregiver questionnaires. Eating behavior was evaluated using the Spanish version of the CEBQ. Anthropometric measurements (weight
column3: and waist circumference) were obtained following a standardized protocol to determine nutritional status and waistto-height ratio. Differences between EBF and non-EBF groups were analyzed using the Wilcoxon–Mann–Whitney and Kruskal–Wallis tests.

column1: Results: Eating behavior scores for pro-intake (“food approach”) were strongly associated with obesity among non-EBF children (ratio = 1.24
column2: p = 0.001). Children with abdominal obesity who were not EBF showed higher scores for food approach behaviors (ratio = 1.22
column3: p = 0.011). A significant trend was observed in the subscale Enjoyment of Food and Emotional vereating in children with obesity (p = 0.011 and p = 0.008)
column4: abdominal obesity (p = 0.031 and p = 0.017)
column5: and cardiometabolic risk (p = 0.036 and p = 0.049) in the non-EBF group
column6: compared to those who were EBF up to 6 months of age.

column1: Conclusions: Scores reflecting a tendency toward higher food intake were strongly associated with obesity and other obesity-related parameters in children who did not experience EBF during early childhood. Having been exclusively breastfed
column3: was associated with lower scores on pro-obesity behaviors.";;;;;;;;Project funded through an internal research fund

Current clinical practice in Latin America is not well described in the literature.

column1: Objectives: Evaluate the  indications and techniques of spinal injections (SI) in patients with degenerative lumbar spinal stenosis (DLSS) among spine surgeons in Latin America.
Study Design: Cross-sectional
Methods: An online survey was sent to spine surgeons and members of the AOSpine Latin America. Data included surgeon geographic information
column4: SI indications
column5: and techniques in different scenarios of pain and stenosis localization. Results: A total of 446 surgeons
column6: 291 (65%) orthopedic surgeons
column7: and 155 (35%) neurosurgeons replied to the survey. 92% of spine surgeons indicated a spinal steroid injection to treat DLSS. Most spinal surgeons (54%) would simultaneously perform both peridural and intraarticular lumbar facet (combined) steroid injections in patients with low back pain and radicular pain. Foraminal injection is a preferred technique for patients with central and foraminal stenosis. There are no significant differences in most of the answers between orthopedic surgeons and neurosurgeons. Almost 80% of respondents expect a good result from the injection. However
column8: 86% of surgeons believe injection effects last less than 6 months
column9: and only 12% think surgery will not be necessary in the future. Only 15% of spine surgeons irrespective of specialty adhere to a guideline on spine injections for DLSS.

column1: Conclusion: This study provides a global perspective on how Latin American spine surgeons treat patients with DLSS concerning the use of spinal steroid injections. We observed that more than 90% of respondents use this procedure to treat DLSS. There are almost no differences between orthopedic spine surgeons and neurosurgeons when performing SI. A foraminal injection is preferred for lateral recess and foraminal stenosis. Most of the respondents expect to achieve  positive results with the procedure
column2: but they believe that its effect will last for less than 6 months and possible need for surgery.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Journal of Spine Research and Surgery

column1: This article analyzes Machado de Assis’s short story O Espelho (1882) from the perspective of moderate semantic holism
column2: arguing that personal  identity can be understood as a discursive phenomenon whose stability depends on networks of belief
column4: and context-sensitive semantic anchors. Rather than adopting a psychological reading focused on inner life
column5: the paper interprets Jacobina’s crisis as a semantic destabilization of self-reference: when the social practices that name and confirm him withdraw
column6: the meaning of the self becomes blurred and indeterminate. The military uniform functions as a reanchoring device that restores identity by reorganizing a contextual economy of relevance. On this view
column7: the story operates as a literary laboratory for examining the semantic dependence of the self and the fragility of identity once its discursive conditions collapse.";;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;HYBRIS. Revista de Filosofía

column1: Introduction: The return to face-to-face classes after the pandemic carried effects that triggered cases of School Violence (SV) in 2022. The newspaper was one of the media that addressed these cases and raised the issue to be discussed by its readers. In this media
column2: letters to the editor are relevant as they show the readers' opinions on a current event
column3: particularly that of experts or influential people from civil society. This type of public discourse in the press deals with argumentative theorizing on the phenomena of school violence and school climate (SC)
column4: so that it can be studied from subjective theories (ST).

column1: Methodology:
Qualitative methodology was followed
column2: using Grounded Theory. The analysis included a process of open and axial coding in the 10 letters to the editor selected. The means chosen for the collection of the sample was the Chilean newspaper La Tercera.

column1: Results: Among the findings
column2: there was a superordinate ST that establishes insufficient coping with SV in the post-pandemic period. In addition
column3: it was found that most of the STs are action initiators to address SC and SV.

column4: Chile;;;;22-03-2022 9:16;;;22-03-2022 9:16;;2022;;;;;Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) causes a microinflammatory and oxidative status that is exacerbated in advanced stages of the disease. This is mainly caused by the accumulation of toxic metabolic wastes such as urea and creatinine

column10: inflammation increases due to this cause
column11: which can lead to the accumulation of molecules of high molecular weight. In this regard

column13: such as curcumin
column14: has been shown to be effective in reducing plasma markers of inflammation and oxidation in patients with various chronic pathologies. This suggests that its regular intake may contribute
column15: to some extent

column17: analyzes and discusses the available scientific evidence on the effect of curcumin intake on inflammation and oxidative stress in HD patients

column2: Andrés;;;;;;;;;;;;;;17-07-2025 14:36;;;2025-07-17T18:36:18Z;;2025;;;;This narrative review addresses the critical issue of arterial transducer positioning for cerebral perfusion pressure (CPP) measurement in neurocritical care. Despite CPP’s importance in guiding management
column3: optimal transducer placement remains ambiguous and unaddressed by current guidelines. We synthesized evidence from 20 relevant articles to inform standardization efforts. Key findings include a 10–12 mmHg CPP discrepancy between phlebostatic axis and Monro foramen transducer locations at 30 degree head elevation. There is no consensus on anatomical landmarks for “head-level” measurement
column4: and only one guideline explicitly advises against the phlebostatic axis approach. Limited clinical evidence suggests increased institutionalization rates for patients with measurement discrepancies. Emerging dual-transducer strategies aim to address these challenges. The review highlights significant variability in CPP measurement practices
column5: potentially impacting patient care and research interpretation. We emphasize the urgent need for standardized protocols and improved reporting in research. Addressing this variability is crucial for optimizing neurocritical care management and enhancing research comparability. Our findings underscore the importance of consistent arterial transducer positioning in neurocritical care and call for further research to establish evidence-based standardization
column6: ultimately improving patient outcomes and research quality in this critical field.;;;;;;;2026-07-06;;;;;;;;;;;;;;Journal of Neurotrauma

column2: Glauben;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;03-11-2022 10:18;;;03-11-2022 10:18;;2022-06-12;;;;;Ulcerative colitis (UC) is an inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and can be treated with glucocorticoids (GC)

column4: being reduced in UC patients. However
column5: the relationship between LRH-1 expression and distribution with altered corticosteroid responses is unknown. To address this
column6: we categorized UC patients by their steroid response. Here
column7: we found that steroid-dependent and refractory patients presented reduced glucocorticoid receptor (GR)-mediated intestinal steroidogenesis compared to healthy individuals and responder patients
column8: possibly related to increased colonic mucosa GR isoform beta (GR?) content and cytoplasmic LRH-1 levels in epithelial and lamina propria cells. Interestingly
column9: an intestinal epithelium-specific GR-induced knockout (GRiKO) dextran sodium sulfate (DSS)-colitis mice model presented decreased epithelial LRH-1 expression
column10: whilst it increased in the lamina propria compared to DSS-treated control mice. Mechanistically
column11: GR directly induced NR5A2 gene expression in CCD841CoN cells and human colonic organoids. Furthermore
column12: GR bound to two glucocorticoid-response elements within the NR5A2 promoter in dexamethasone-stimulated CCD841CoN cells. We conclude that GR contributes to intestinal steroidogenesis by inducing LRH-1 in epithelial cells
column13: suggesting LRH-1 as a potential marker for glucocorticoid-impaired response in UC. However

column5: Chile;;;;;;16-05-2018 10:57;;;16-05-2018 10:57;;2017;;;;"Una de las etapas más importantes para el éxito del tratamiento es la

column1: este tema aún sigue siendo motivo de investigación.
El objetivo de este estudio fue demostrar que el análisis cefalométrico de
Tatis permite discriminar fielmente las variaciones en la DVO en pacientes
desdentados totales.
Se utilizó una muestra de 12 individuos desdentados totales con un
promedio de edad de 70 años
column2: que acuden a la clínica de CAS – 509 de la

column1: Universidad Finis Terrae durante el año 2017. Los criterios de exclusión fueron la

column4: Enfermedad

column1: renal y Disfunción TémporoMandibular. La muestra fue dividida en tres grupos: a

column2: a otro se le disminuyó en 2 mm y al

column1: tercer grupo se le mantuvo la DVO. Las modificaciones fueron mantenidas en
secreto. Posteriormente se tomó una ortopantomografía a cada paciente. Se utilizó
el análisis cefalométrico de Tatis para medir la altura del tercio inferior de la cara.

clínicamente.

clínicamente aumentada con un triángulo isósceles alargado verticalmente.

presentan una mayor correlación con los triángulos descritos por el análisis
cefalométrico de Tatis.
Por lo que se aconseja usar este análisis como método complementario y
no decisivo para la determinación de la DV.";;;;;;;;;;;;;Tesis (Cirujano Dentista)--Universidad Finis Terrae

column1: Purpose: To determine how PTS modifies the protective effect of LET in high-risk patients and to evaluate the influence of PTS on graft failure across different risk profiles.
Study Design: Cohort study; Level of evidence

Methods: A retrospective cohort of 585 patients who underwent primary ACL reconstruction (ACLR) with hamstring tendon autografts between 2014 and 2017 was analyzed at a minimum follow-up of 6 years. Patients were nonrandomly allocated according to predefined clinical risk criteria into a low-risk group (isolated ACLR) and a high-risk group (ACLR 1 LET). A graft rerupture was defined clinically and confirmed by imaging. Multivariable logistic regression was used to assess the association between PTS and graft failure. Restricted cubic spline regression was also used to explore nonlinear relationships and identify slope ranges associated with low and high failure probabilities.
Results: PTS independently predicted a graft rerupture in both groups
column2: with a stronger effect in the high-risk group (adjusted odds ratio
column3: 1.63; P = .005) compared with the low-risk group (adjusted odds ratio
column4: 1.21; P = .029). The relationship between PTS and graft failure was nonlinear. In the high-risk group
column5: the lowest failure probabilities were observed within a PTS range of 5 to 9
column6: below which the risk of failure plateaued. In contrast
column7: PTS values exceeding 11 to 12 were associated with high failure probabilities in both groups.

column1: Conclusion: PTS was independently associated with graft failure in both groups. Although LET was associated with lower failure probabilities within a moderate slope range

column2: sometido a reemplazo valvular mitral y anuloplastia tricuspídea. En el postoperatorio inmediato

column11: la cual fue reparada exitosamente. Permaneció 12 días en ECMO y evolucionó sin secuelas neurológicas.
